notes: This is a new minimal reset configuration, not a copied or modified SimuHome benchmark episode.
It contains no model prompts, ground-truth benchmark labels, or upstream episode data.

Room temperature and HVAC LocalTemperature are both initialized to 2900 so the reset snapshot is internally aligned. Temperature and setpoint values use the backend's apparent 0.01 degree Celsius integer representation; the scale is not physically calibrated.
The file is an input fixture only. It does not indicate that the upstream simulator has been installed or run.

cool.description: One high-level HomeCoord proposal; sequential device commands share one proposal_id and command_bundle_id.

off.description: One high-level HomeCoord proposal mapping to one off command.

acceptance_checks_before_use: Reset response reports one living_room, one HVAC device, and the authored initial attributes.
Temperature readback and thermostat LocalTemperature agree on the backend's scale; do not assume 2900 means 29 Celsius until verified.
The cool bundle succeeds in order and leaves OnOff=true, SystemMode=3, OccupiedCoolingSetpoint=2400, PercentSetting=66.
The off command succeeds and leaves OnOff=false; device temperature evolution is evaluated separately.
Readback and reset repeat exactly three times before scheduling paired runs.
